<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font color="#FF0000"><b><font size=2>About Your Fund&#146;s Expenses</font></b></font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>As a shareholder of the fund, you incur ongoing costs, which include costs for portfolio management, administrative services, and shareholder reports (like this one), among others. Operating expenses, which are deducted from a fund&#146;s gross income, directly reduce the investment return of the fund. </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>A fund&#146;s expenses are expressed as a percentage of its average net assets. This figure is known as the expense ratio. The following examples are intended to help you understand the ongoing costs (in dollars) of investing in your fund and to compare these costs with those of other mutual funds. The examples are based on an investment of $1,000 made at the beginning of the period shown and held for the entire period. </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>The tables illustrate your fund&#146;s costs in two ways: </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>&#149; Based on actual fund return.</font></b><font size=2> This section helps you to estimate the actual expenses that you paid over the period. The &#147;Ending Account Value&#148; shown is derived from the fund&#146;s actual return, and the third column shows the dollar amount that would have been paid by an investor who started with $1,000 in the fund. You may use the information here, together with the amount you invested, to estimate the expenses that you paid over the period. </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;'><font size=2>To do so, simply divide your account value by $1,000 (for example, an $8,600 account value divided by $1,000 = 8.6), then multiply the result by the number given for your fund under the heading &#147;Expenses Paid During Period.&#148; </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>&#149; Based on hypothetical 5% yearly return.</font></b><font size=2> This section is intended to help you compare your fund&#146;s costs with those of other mutual funds. It assumes that the fund had a yearly return of 5% before expenses, but that the expense ratio is unchanged. In this case&#151;because the return used is not the fund&#146;s actual return&#151;the results do not apply to your investment. The example is useful in making comparisons because the Securities and Exchange Commission requires all mutual funds to calculate expenses based on a 5% return. You can assess your fund&#146;s costs by comparing this hypothetical example with the hypothetical examples that appear in shareholder reports of other funds. </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>Note that the expenses shown in the tables are meant to highlight and help you compare </font><i><font size=2>ongoing </font></i><font size=2>costs only and do not reflect any transactional costs or account maintenance fees. They do not include your fund&#146;s low-balance fee, which is described in the prospectus. If this fee were applied to your account, your costs would be higher. Your fund does not charge transaction fees, such as purchase or redemption fees, nor does it carry a &#147;sales load.&#148;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;'><font size=2>The calculations assume no shares were bought or sold during the period. Your actual costs may have been higher or lower, depending on the amount of your investment and the timing of any purchases or redemptions. </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>You can find more information about the fund&#146;s expenses, including annual expense ratios, in the Financial Statements section of this report. For additional information on operating expenses and other shareholder costs, please refer to the appropriate fund prospectus.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font color="#FF0000"><b><font size=2>Glossary </font></b></font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Beta.</font></b><font size=2> A measure of the magnitude of a fund&#146;s past share-price fluctuations in relation to the ups and downs of a given market index. The index is assigned a beta of 1.00. Compared with a given index, a fund with a beta of 1.20 typically would have seen its share price rise or fall by 12% when the index rose or fell by 10%. A fund&#146;s beta should be reviewed in conjunction with its R-squared (see definition below). The lower the R-squared, the less correlation there is between the fund and the index, and the less reliable beta is as an indicator of volatility.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Earnings Growth Rate.</font></b><font size=2> The average annual rate of growth in earnings over the past five years for the stocks now in a fund.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Expense Ratio.</font></b><font size=2> The percentage of a fund&#146;s average net assets used to pay its annual administrative and advisory expenses. These expenses directly reduce returns to investors.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Foreign Holdings.</font></b><font size=2> The percentage of a fund represented by stocks or depositary receipts of companies based outside the United States.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Inception Date.</font></b><font size=2> The date on which the assets of a fund (or one of its share classes) are first invested in accordance with the fund&#146;s investment objective. For funds with a subscription period, the inception date is the day after that period ends. Investment performance is measured from the inception date.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Median Market Cap. </font></b><font size=2>An indicator of the size of companies in which a fund invests; the midpoint of market capitalization (market price x shares outstanding) of a fund&#146;s stocks, weighted by the proportion of the fund&#146;s assets invested in each stock. Stocks representing half of the fund&#146;s assets have market capitalizations above the median, and the rest are below it.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Price/Book Ratio.</font></b><font size=2> The share price of a stock divided by its net worth, or book value, per share. For a fund, the weighted average price/book ratio of the stocks it holds.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;'><b><font size=2>Price/Earnings Ratio.</font></b><font size=2> The ratio of a stock&#146;s current price to its per-share earnings over the past year. For a fund, the weighted average P/E of the stocks it holds. P/E is an indicator of market expectations about corporate prospects; the higher the P/E, the greater the expectations for a company&#146;s future growth.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>R-Squared.</font></b><font size=2> A measure of how much of a fund&#146;s past returns can be explained by the returns from the market in general, as measured by a given index. If a fund&#146;s total returns were precisely synchronized with an index&#146;s returns, its R-squared would be 1.00. If the fund&#146;s returns bore no relationship to the index&#146;s returns, its R-squared would be 0.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Return on Equity.</font></b><font size=2> The annual average rate of return generated by a company during the past five years for each dollar of shareholder&#146;s equity (net income divided by shareholder&#146;s equity). For a fund, the weighted average return on equity for the companies whose stocks it holds.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Short-Term Reserves.</font></b><font size=2> The percentage of a fund invested in highly liquid, short-term securities that can be readily converted to cash.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Turnover Rate.</font></b><font size=2> An indication of the fund&#146;s trading activity. Funds with high turnover rates incur higher transaction costs and may be more likely to distribute capital gains (which may be taxable to investors). The turnover rate excludes in-kind transactions, which have minimal impact on costs.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><b><font size=2>Yield.</font></b><font size=2> A snapshot of a fund&#146;s income from interest and dividends. The yield, expressed as a percentage of the fund&#146;s net asset value, is based on income earned over the past 30 days and is annualized, or projected forward for the coming year. The index yield is based on the current annualized rate of income provided by securities in the index.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:center;'><font size=2>80</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;'><font color="#FF0000"><b><font size=2>The People Who Govern Your Fund</font></b></font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>The trustees of your mutual fund are there to see that the fund is operated and managed in your best interests since, as a shareholder, you are a part owner of the fund. Your fund&#146;s trustees also serve on the board of directors of The Vanguard Group, Inc., which is owned by the Vanguard funds and provides services to them on an at-cost basis.</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>A majority of Vanguard&#146;s board members are independent, meaning that they have no affiliation with Vanguard or the funds they oversee, apart from the sizable personal investments they have made as private individuals. </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>Our independent board members bring distinguished backgrounds in business, academia, and public service to their task of working with Vanguard officers to establish the policies and oversee the activities of the funds. Among board members&#146; responsibilities are selecting investment advisors for the funds; monitoring fund operations, performance, and costs; reviewing contracts; nominating and selecting new trustees/directors; and electing Vanguard officers. </font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>Each trustee serves a fund until its termination; or until the trustee&#146;s retirement, resignation, or death; or otherwise as specified in the fund&#146;s organizational documents. Any trustee may be removed at a shareholders&#146; meeting by a vote representing two-thirds of the net asset value of all shares of the fund together with shares of other Vanguard funds organized within the same trust. The table on these two pages shows information for each trustee and executive officer of the fund. The mailing address of the trustees and officers is P.O. Box 876, Valley Forge, PA 19482.  </font></p>

                                                 <p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font color="#FF0000"><b><font size=2>As of December 31, 2006</font></b></font></p>

                                                 <p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>&nbsp;</font></p>

                                                 <p style=' margin-bottom:3.7pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>This Statement summarizes the fund&#146;s holdings by asset type (common stocks, bonds, etc.) and by industry sector. Details are reported for each of the fund&#146;s 50 largest individual holdings and for investments that, in total for any issuer, represent more than 1% of the fund&#146;s net assets. The total value of smaller holdings is reported as a single amount within each category. </font></p>

                                                 <p style=' margin-bottom:0pt; margin-top:0pt;text-align:left;'><font size=2>The fund provides a complete list of its holdings four times in each fiscal year, at the quarter-ends. For the second and fourth fiscal quarters, the complete listing of the fund&#146;s holdings is available electronically on Vanguard.com<sup>&reg; </sup>and on the Securities and Exchange Commission&#146;s website (www.sec.gov), or you can have it mailed to you without charge by calling 800-662-7447. For the first and third fiscal quarters, the fund files the lists with the SEC on Form N-Q. Shareholders can look up the fund&#146;s Forms N-Q on the SEC&#146;s website. Forms N-Q may also be reviewed and copied at the SEC&#146;s Public Reference Room (see the back cover of the accompanying report for further information).</font></p>

Audit Committee meeting, and to determine if such services would be consistent with
maintaining the accountant&#146;s independence. At the next scheduled Audit Committee
meeting, services and fees would be presented to the Audit Committee for formal
consideration, and, if appropriate, approval by the entire Audit Committee. The Audit

maintaining the principal accountant&#146;s independence. </FONT></P>

     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>1.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; I
          have reviewed this report on Form N-CSR of Vanguard Index Funds;</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>2.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Based on my knowledge, this report does not contain any untrue statement of a
          material fact or omit to state a material fact necessary to make the statements
          made, in light of the circumstances under which such statements were made, not
          misleading with respect to the period covered by this report;</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>3.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Based on my knowledge, the financial statements, and other financial information
          included in this report, fairly present in all material respects the financial
          condition, results of operations, changes in net assets, and cash flows (if the
          financial statements are required to include a statement of cash flows) of the
          registrant as of, and for, the periods presented in this report;</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>4.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          The registrant&#146;s other certifying officer(s) and I are responsible for
          establishing and maintaining disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in
          Rule 30a-3(c) under the Investment Company Act of 1940) and internal control
          over financial reporting (as defined in Rule 30a-3(d) under the Investment
          Company Act of 1940) for the registrant and have:</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>(a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Designed such disclosure controls and procedures, or caused such disclosure
          controls and procedures to be designed under our supervision, to ensure that
          material information relating to the registrant, including its consolidated
          subsidiaries, is made known to us by others within those entities, particularly
          during the period in which this report is being prepared;</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>(b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Designed such internal control over financial reporting, or caused such internal
          control over financial reporting to be designed under our supervision, to
          provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting
          and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance
          with generally accepted accounting principles;</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>(c)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Evaluated the effectiveness of the registrant&#146;s disclosure controls and
          procedures and presented in this report our conclusions about the effectiveness
          of the disclosure controls and procedures, as of a date within 90 days prior to
          the filing date of this report based on such evaluation; and</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>(d)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Disclosed in this report any change in the registrant&#146;s internal control
          over financial reporting that occurred during the second fiscal quarter of the
          period covered by this report that has materially affected, or is reasonably
          likely to materially affect, the registrant&#146;s internal control over
          financial reporting; and</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>5.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          The registrant&#146;s other certifying officer(s) and I have disclosed to the
          registrant&#146;s auditors and the audit committee of the registrant&#146;s
          board of directors (or persons performing the equivalent functions):</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>(a)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          All significant deficiencies and material weaknesses in the design or operation
          of internal control over financial reporting which are reasonably likely to
          adversely affect the registrant&#146;s ability to record, process, summarize,
          and report financial information; and</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Flush Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>(b)&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Any fraud, whether or not material, that involves management or other employees
          who have a significant role in the registrant&#146;s internal control over

<H1 ALIGN=CENTER><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>THE VANGUARD FUNDS&#146;<BR>CODE OF ETHICS<BR>
FOR<BR>SENIOR EXECUTIVE AND FINANCIAL OFFICERS </FONT></H1>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Head Major Left Bold-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<H1 ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>I. Introduction </FONT></H1>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Indent Lv 0-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;The
Board of Trustees of each registered investment company that is managed, sponsored, and
distributed by The Vanguard Group, Inc. (&#147;VGI&#148;) (each a &#147;Vanguard
Fund&#148; and collectively the &#147;Vanguard Funds&#148;) has adopted this code of
ethics (the &#147;Code&#148;) as required by Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act. The
Code applies to the individuals in positions listed on Exhibit A (the &#147;Covered
Officers&#148;). All Covered Officers, along with employees of The Vanguard Group, Inc.,
are subject to separate and distinct obligations from this Code under a Code of Ethics
adopted pursuant to Rule 17j-1 under the Investment Company Act of 1940 (&#147;17j-1 Code
of Ethics&#148;), policies to prevent the misuse of non-public information, and other
internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be in effect from time to time. </FONT></P>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Hang Lv 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
<TR VALIGN=TOP>
<TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>This Code is designed to promote:</FONT></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<BR>
<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Hang Lv 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
<TR VALIGN=TOP>
<TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&#149;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>Honest
and ethical conduct, including the ethical handling of conflicts of interest; </FONT></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<BR>
<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Hang Lv 1-Arial" FSL="Default" -->
<TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
<TR VALIGN=TOP>
<TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2></FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&#149;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
Full, fair, accurate, timely, and understandable disclosure in reports and documents that
a Vanguard Fund files with, or submits to, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, or
in other public communications made by the Vanguard Funds or VGI; </FONT></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Hang Lv 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->

<TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&#149;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>Compliance
with applicable laws, governmental rules, and regulations; </FONT></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Hang Lv 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>

<TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>Prompt
internal reporting to those identified in the Code of violations of the Code; and </FONT></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Hang Lv 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->

<TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>Accountability
for adherence to the Code. </FONT></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Head Major Left Bold-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<H1 ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>II. Actual or Apparent
Conflicts of Interest </FONT></H1>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Indent Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Covered Officers should conduct all activities in accordance with the following
          principles: </FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>1. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          <U>Shareholders&#146; interests come first</U>. In the course of fulfilling
          their duties and responsibilities to Vanguard Fund shareholders, Covered
          Officers must at all times place the interests of Vanguard Fund shareholders
          first. In particular, Covered Officers must avoid serving their own personal
          interests ahead of the interests of Vanguard Fund shareholders. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>2. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          <U>Conflicts of interest must be avoided</U>. Covered Officers must avoid any
          situation involving an actual or potential conflict of interest or possible
          impropriety with respect to their duties and responsibilities to Vanguard Fund
          shareholders. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>3. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          <U>Compromising situations must be avoided</U>. Covered Officers must not take
          advantage of their position of trust and responsibility. Covered Officers must
          avoid any situation that might compromise or call into question their exercise
          of full independent judgment in the best interests of Vanguard Fund
          shareholders. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>


<P ALIGN=CENTER><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="page-break-after:always"></P>
<!-- MARKER PAGE="sheet: 1; page: 1" -->
<HR SIZE=5 COLOR=GRAY NOSHADE>



<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Flush Lv 0-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>All activities of Covered Officers
should be guided by and adhere to these fiduciary standards regardless of whether the
activity is specifically described in this Code. </FONT></P>
<BR>
<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Head Sub 2 Left-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<P ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>B.  Restricted Activities</FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>1. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          <U>Prohibition on secondary employment</U>. Covered Officers are prohibited from
          accepting or serving in any form of secondary employment. Secondary employment
          that does not create a potential conflict of interest may be approved by the
          General Counsel of VGI. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>2. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          <U>Prohibition on service as director or public official</U>. Unless approved by
          the General Counsel of VGI, Covered Officers are prohibited from serving on the
          board of directors of any publicly traded company or in an official capacity for
          any federal, state, or local government (or governmental agency or
          instrumentality). </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>3. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          <U>Prohibition on misuse of Vanguard time or property</U>. Covered Officers are
          prohibited from making use of time, equipment, services, personnel or property
          of any Vanguard entity for any purposes other than the performance of their
          duties and responsibilities in connection with the Vanguard Funds or other
          Vanguard-related entities. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Head Major Left Bold-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<H1 ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>III. Disclosure and
Compliance </FONT></H1>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang LV 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
          <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
               <TR VALIGN=TOP>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>A. </FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
               Each Covered Officer should be familiar with the disclosure requirements
               generally applicable to the Vanguard Funds. </FONT></TD>
               </TR>
               </TABLE>
               <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang LV 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
          <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
               <TR VALIGN=TOP>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>B. </FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
               Each Covered Officer should not knowingly misrepresent, or cause others to
               misrepresent, facts about the Vanguard Funds to others, including to the
               Vanguard Funds&#146; directors and auditors, or to government regulators and
               self-regulatory organizations. </FONT></TD>
               </TR>
               </TABLE>
               <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang LV 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
          <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
               <TR VALIGN=TOP>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>C. </FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
               Each Covered Officer should, to the extent appropriate within the Covered
               Officer&#146;s area of responsibility, consult with other officers and employees
               of VGI and advisers to a Vanguard Fund with the goal of promoting full, fair,
               accurate, timely and understandable disclosure in the reports and documents the
               fund files with, or submits to, the SEC and in other public communications made
               by a Vanguard Fund. </FONT></TD>
               </TR>
               </TABLE>
               <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang LV 1-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
          <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
               <TR VALIGN=TOP>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=5%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>D. </FONT></TD>
               <TD WIDTH=90%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
               It is the responsibility of each Covered Officer to promote compliance with the
               standards and restrictions imposed by applicable laws, rules, regulations, and
               the 17j-1 Code of Ethics. </FONT></TD>
               </TR>
               </TABLE>
               <BR>

<H1 ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>IV. Reporting and
Accountability </FONT></H1>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Indent Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;A.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          Each Covered Officer must: </FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>1. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          Upon adoption or amendment of the Code (or thereafter as applicable, upon
          becoming a Covered Officer), affirm in writing that he or she has received,
          read, and understands the Code; </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>2. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          Affirm at least annually in writing that he or she has complied with the
          requirements of the Code; </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>3. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          Not retaliate against any other Covered Officer or any employee of VGI for
          reports of potential violations of the Code that are made in good faith; and </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>4. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          Notify the General Counsel of VGI promptly if the Covered Officer knows of any
          violations of this Code. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Indent Lv 0- Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;B.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;
          The Vanguard Funds will use the following procedures in investigating and
          enforcing this Code: </FONT></P>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=3%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>1. </FONT></TD>
          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          The General Counsel of VGI is responsible for applying this Code to specific
          situations and has the authority to interpret this Code in any particular
          situation. The General Counsel will report on an as-needed basis to the Board of
          Trustees regarding activities subject to the Code. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>

          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          The General Counsel will take all appropriate action to investigate any
          potential violations of the Code that are reported to him. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>
          <TD WIDTH=10%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;</FONT></TD>

          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          If, after investigation, the General Counsel believes that no material violation
          of the Code has occurred, the General Counsel is not required to take any
          further action. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
     <TABLE WIDTH=100% CELLPADDING=0 CELLSPACING=0 BORDER=0>
          <TR VALIGN=TOP>

          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          Any matter that the General Counsel believes is a material violation of the Code
          will be reported to the Board of Trustees of the Vanguard Funds. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>
          <BR>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para (List) Hang Lvl 3-Arial" FSL="Project" -->

          <TD WIDTH=87%><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>
          If the Board of Trustees of the Vanguard Funds concurs that a material violation
          of the Code has occurred, the Board will consider appropriate action.
          Appropriate action may include reassignment, suspension, or dismissal of the
          applicable Covered Officer(s), or any other sanctions the Board deems
          appropriate. Appropriate action may also include review of, and appropriate
          modifications to, applicable policies and procedures. </FONT></TD>
          </TR>
          </TABLE>

<H1 ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>V. Other Policies and
Procedures </FONT></H1>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Indent Lv 0-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;This
Code shall be the sole code of conduct adopted by the Vanguard Funds for purposes of
Section 406 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and the rules and forms applicable to registered
investment companies thereunder. Insofar as other policies or procedures of the Vanguard
Funds, VGI, or other service providers govern or purport to govern the behavior or
activities of the Covered Officers, they are superseded by this Code to the extent that
they overlap or conflict with the provisions of this Code. </FONT></P>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Indent Lv 0-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;VGI&#146;s
and the Vanguard Funds&#146; 17j-1 Code of Ethics, policies to prevent the misuse of
non-public information, and other internal compliance guidelines and policies that may be
in effect from time to time are separate requirements applying to the Covered Officers and
others, and are not part of this Code. </FONT></P>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Head Major Left Bold-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<H1 ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>VI. Amendments </FONT></H1>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Indent Lv 0-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;This
Code may not be materially amended except by the approval of a majority vote of the
independent trustees of the Vanguard Funds&#146; Board of Trustees. Non-material,
technical, and administrative revisions of the Code do not have to be approved by the
Board of Trustees. Amendments must be in writing and communicated promptly to the Covered
Officers, who shall affirm receipt of the amended Code in accordance with Section IV. A.
1.</FONT></P>

<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Head Major Left Bold-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<H1 ALIGN=LEFT><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>VII. Confidentiality </FONT></H1>


<!-- MARKER FORMAT-SHEET="Para Large Indent Lv 0-Arial" FSL="Project" -->
<P><FONT FACE="Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif" SIZE=2>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;All
reports and records prepared or maintained pursuant to this Code shall be considered
confidential and shall be maintained and protected accordingly. Except as otherwise
required by law or this Code, such matters shall not be disclosed to anyone other than the
Vanguard Funds&#146; Board of Trustees and VGI&#146;s General Counsel. </FONT></P>
